# Query Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [AnyByField](/docs/standard-library/query/anybyfield) | Tells whether any object in an array has a field that passes a comparison. |
| [AllByField](/docs/standard-library/query/allbyfield) | Tells whether every element of an array is an object whose field passes a comparison. |
| [FindByField](/docs/standard-library/query/findbyfield) | Finds the first object in an array whose field passes a comparison. |
| [WhereByField](/docs/standard-library/query/wherebyfield) | Selects the objects in an array whose field passes a comparison. |
| [Select](/docs/standard-library/query/select) | Takes the value of one field from each element of an array. |
| [Project](/docs/standard-library/query/project) | Builds, for each object in an array, a new object with only the listed fields. |
| [Omit](/docs/standard-library/query/omit) | Builds, for each object in an array, a new object without the listed fields. |
| [CountIf](/docs/standard-library/query/countif) | Counts the objects in an array whose field passes a comparison. |
